exclusions.reason: The OP performs grant-based (subject-scoped) back-channel logout and advertises backchannel_logout_session_supported: false, which is spec-legal (the OIDC Back-Channel Logout metadata is optional). This certification module unconditionally requires session_supported: true. Session-scoped sid logout is an opt-in profile planned for a future minor; sub-only logout is the fail-secure default.
Cascades from the discovery-endpoint-verification module above: the plan aborts on the session_supported assertion before this module can run. Same rationale as that exclusion.
